About Inmobilia

Inmobilia is a real estate developer headquartered in Mérida, Yucatán, with more than three decades of activity across southern Mexico. Its portfolio spans golf communities, tourism, luxury housing, mixed-use districts and corporate space, including Yucatan Country Club and Vía Montejo in Mérida and Four Seasons Caye Chapel in Belize. The company reports more than 7.8 million square metres developed and often works through partnerships with hotel operators, architecture studios and other developers.

In Tulum, its main undertaking is Tulum 101, which the company presents as the first master-planned community of macro-lots in the destination. The plan divides land into parcels for housing, hotels and commerce, with other developers building individual projects inside it, such as SIMCA's Gran Tulum. Inmobilia also markets branded residential projects in Tulum, among them Mayaliah Tulum MGallery and Faena Residences Tulum, reflecting a focus on hospitality-linked homes.

Key areas of activity

  • Master-planned communities
  • Residential lots and macro-lots
  • Branded and hotel-linked residences
  • Mixed-use and commercial districts
  • Golf communities

01 Master-planned community (macro-lots)

Tulum 101

Tulum, Quintana Roo

A gated master plan near the beach divided into macro-lots for residential, hotel and commercial use, with underground utilities and fibre optics. It hosts several sub-projects by Inmobilia and partner developers.
